basic_info.description: Classic Mission flat in a priceless location! Flexible floor-plan with 2 living rooms. Situated in a highly desirable pocket of the Mission District, you're just blocks to endless dining and nightlife options at all ends of the spectrum. 93 Walkscore! Spacious kitchen and functional floor-plan with in-unit laundry, radiant heating, private deck, newer water heater (2017), 1-car tandem parking, low monthly HOAs, and a shared garden. Close proximity to BART, Muni lines, tech shuttles and HWYs 280 & 101, or a quick ride-share to downtown/FiDi. A commuter's paradise!
